fair_value_reason: FY27 EPS of about $19.2 (consensus $20.00 less about 4%), rolled to an NTM EPS of about $22 at Oct 2027, at about 15x = about $330. Cross-checks: FY27E FCF of about $6.4B / about 328M shares at a 6-6.3% yield = about $310-325; EV/EBITDA of 11-12x on about $8.1B less $0.46B net debt = about $290-320. Blended about $322, against the agents' $310-348 (mean $326). I give a little less weight to agent_1's 16x NTM re-rating, which revisions do not yet support. Share base: 335.3M at Jun 30 2026, falling to about 326-330M with buybacks.
supervisor_summary: The five revised forecasts agree closely: median about $300, P(>= $281 on 2027-10-01) about 0.55, fair values $310-348. The stock is about 14x FY27 EPS and about a 6% FCF yield after a 60% de-rating. My checks reversed one round-1 supervisor fact: the CEO's 2026 sales were discretionary, not under a 10b5-1 plan, which adds a little to the class-action risk. They also confirmed that Unity is growing about twice as fast as AppLovin sequentially and that the two are now in litigation over MAX data. Neither moves the centre, so I keep the mean ladder (low confidence) with fair value about $322 and thesis break $185. The Q3 print and Q4 guide, likely Nov 4, are the next real test.
key_drivers: Q3 2026 print (likely Wed Nov 4, unconfirmed) against the $2.055-2.085B guide, and above all the Q4 guide against Edgewater's +8-9% q/q (about $2.25B) and the about $2.27-2.28B consensus.

Gaming share and spreads against Unity: Unity Strategic Grow guided +68-70% y/y for Q3 (about +16% q/q) against AppLovin's about +7.6% q/q; the AppLovin v. Unity TRO/arbitration over MAX auction data.
Whether e-commerce/self-serve adoption shows up on traffic-weighted data (Wells Fargo: about 85% of new pixel sites have no traffic; a '2027 story').
Estimate revisions: FY27 EPS went from $21.16 to $20.00 in 60 days (19 down / 5 up). The 14x multiple will not re-rate until revisions turn.

Valuation floor and capital return: about 14x FY27 EPS and about 6% FCF yield, $1.5B bought back in H1 2026 with $1.8B left, net debt about $0.46B. Legal overhang: two class actions, made somewhat stronger by the CEO's discretionary sales of about $51m in June 2026 inside the class period.
